name: maintenance-renewal-audit
description: Separate documented service obligations from optional renewals and diagnose due-date, ownership and fulfillment gaps.

interface.longDescription: Separate documented service obligations from optional renewals and diagnose due-date, ownership and fulfillment gaps. For home service owners and teams. Delivers editable company-branded Markdown plus styled HTML, evidence labels and an internally usable implementation blueprint. Matches verified website branding or owner-selected trade palettes. Qualitative findings are valid when data is missing. Conditional financial opportunity is not guaranteed. Plans and drafts only; no live integrations, automatic outreach, calendar changes or monitoring. AI Growth Studio is the developer; optional implementation support is separate from the audit.
defaultPrompt: Audit how we track due maintenance visits and expiring service agreements.
